subject: general
question: The sum of five numbers is 655. The average of the first two numbers is 80 and the third number is 102. Find the average of the remaining two numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of remaining two numbers = Total sum − (Sum of first two + Third number)

Sum of remaining two = 655 − (2 × 80 + 102) = 655 − 262 = 393

Average of remaining two = 393 ÷ 2 = 196.5

**∴ The correct answer is 196.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of five numbers = 655

Average of the first two numbers = 80

Third number = 102

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 
 
 
 

 
 First Two
 Sum = 160
 
 Third
 102
 
 Remaining Two
 Sum = 393

 
 

 
• 
 Total Sum = 655

 
 Average of Remaining Two = 393 / 2 = 196.5

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of the first two numbers = 80 × 2 = 160

⇒ Sum of the first three numbers = 160 + 102 = 262

⇒ Sum of the remaining two numbers = 655 − 262 = 393

⇒ Average of the remaining two numbers = 393 ÷ 2 = 196.5

**∴ The correct answer is 196.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When combining multiple groups with different averages, the overall average is found using the weighted average formula: Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Combined Sum Property

The sum of an entire dataset is simply the sum of its non-overlapping subsets. Total Sum = Sum(Subset 1) + Sum(Subset 2) + ... + Sum(Subset n).

Net Deviation Method

Instead of calculating raw sums, averages can be computed by assuming a base average and finding the net deviations of the given numbers. The true average is Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Count).
